cards.example: Pasakit ng implasyon ang pasan ng bawat pamilyang Pilipino ngayon.
cards.exampleMeaning: The hardship of inflation is what every Filipino family is carrying now.
cards.note: Mabigat at pangmatagalang hirap na dinaranas ng marami; mas malalim kaysa 'hirap' at madalas nasa pormal o madamdaming balita.
cards.tiesTo: BSP hikes 50 bp as inflation stays above 7%

cards.example: Panunuya ang dating ng sinabi ng embahador sa mga mambabatas.
cards.exampleMeaning: The ambassador's remark came across as mockery toward the lawmakers.
cards.note: Pangungutya na may halong pang-iinsulto; mas matalas kaysa 'biro' at mas mapanlait kaysa 'tukso'.
cards.tiesTo: Chinese envoy row with Philippine lawmakers

cards.example: 收入大涨，利润反倒增长有限。
cards.examplePinyin: Shōurù dàzhǎng, lìrùn fǎndào zēngzhǎng yǒuxiàn.
cards.exampleMeaning: Revenue surged, but profit instead grew only a little.
cards.note: 口语-leaning connective for a result that runs against expectation. Contrast 反而 (neutral, common in writing too) — 反倒 is slightly more conversational and emphatic.

cards.example: 原材料成本上升，压缩了企业的利润空间。
cards.examplePinyin: Yuáncáiliào chéngběn shàngshēng, yāsuō le qǐyè de lìrùn kōngjiān.
cards.exampleMeaning: Rising raw-material costs squeezed companies' profit margins.
cards.note: 书面语/neutral finance term. Collocates with 利润率, 利润空间, 压缩/侵蚀利润. Contrast 收益 (returns, from investment) and 盈利 (earnings, verb-like) — 利润 is the accounting profit line.
